title: Assembling finite Chern normalization from the two arrow comparisons
statement: For Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], assume IntegralBoundaryNormalization [def-sfb-integral-boundary-normalization] for every lineBundleClass and ScalarFiniteBoundary [def-sfb-scalar-finite-boundary] for every integral arrow and finite level. Then c satisfies the original FiniteChernNormalization [def-sp-tower-class-finite]. This is the fully proved substitution of the integral Kummer equality into scalar/finite compatibility.

proof.text: At each line bundle and level, use the scalar comparison at firstChernR. Apply congrArg of exact finite evaluation to the proved integral normalization. The proved forgetEvaluatedArrow_firstChernR identity identifies the scalar/evaluated arrow with the existing evaluatedChern after forgetting. Transport the two HEq fields of finiteBoundaryEquality by these two identities, retaining its actual commuting square unchanged. This avoids rewriting the entire proposition with its coefficient-category witnesses.

Use towerKummerBoundary_evaluation to identify the named positive boundary after evaluation with the original kummerComposite required by FiniteChernNormalization. Compose the two HEq witnesses, retaining the same commuting-square equality.

theorem finiteChernNormalization_of_arrowComparisons (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (hi : ∀ L : T.Pic, IntegralBoundaryNormalization l
      (Rrings l T) (Arings l E T) (coefficientSystemMap l E T) c (lineBundleClass T L))
    (hs : ∀ (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
          c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) (n : ℕ), ScalarFiniteBoundary l E c f n) :
    FiniteChernNormalization l E c
